proof_summary: A structural analysis of iterated run-length encodings (with finitely many initial cases) yields the eventual recurrences \(a_{n+1}=a_n+L_n\), \(L_{n+1}=L_n+C_n\), and \(C_{n+1}=C_n+a_{n-4}+3\). Choosing \(\lambda>1\) with \(\lambda^4(\lambda-1)^3=1\), a positive linear combination of these quantities and four delayed values of \(a_n+3\) scales exactly by \(\lambda\), giving constant-factor bounds on \(a_n+3\) by \(\lambda^n\); taking nth roots and observing that \((a_n/(a_n+3))^{1/n}\to1\) proves convergence.
